insight: Launched as Scout before rebranding to Fetcher; its 2022 Series B brought total funding to about $40M.
name: Fetcher
tagline: AI candidate sourcing that pairs automation with human recruiters.
description: Fetcher automates outbound recruiting — its AI assembles batches of qualified candidates for a role, then runs personalized multi-step email outreach and syncs everyone into your ATS and CRM. Teams use it for both passive sourcing and sorting inbound applicants, with diversity targets built into the search.
edge: Layers a managed team of human 'sourcers' on top of the AI, so curated candidate lists arrive vetted rather than as raw search results.

references.title: Fetcher Brings In $27 Million for Automated Candidate Sourcing
